TITLE:
The picture is changing —
can you spot it?
NEXT: NEXT: While you counted passes, what went by?

EN.그림을 15초 동안 잘 보세요\n뭔가 달라지면 찾아보세요:
Watch the picture closely for 15 seconds.
If something changes, find it
EN.이건 바로 보이죠?: You see that right away, don't you?
EN.눈은 그림 전체를\n사진처럼 찍어 두지 않아요:
Your eyes don't store the whole picture
like a photo
EN.보고 있는 곳만 그때그때\n자세히 볼 뿐이에요:
They only look closely at
where you're looking, moment by moment
EN.갑자기 바뀌면 \"바뀌었다!\" 신호가\n시선을 확 끌어요:
A sudden change sends a "something changed!" signal
that grabs your attention
EN.천천히 바뀌면 그 신호가 없어서\n바뀌는 걸 쉽게 놓쳐요:
A slow change has no such signal,
so it's easy to miss
EN.영화에서 컵 자리가 바뀌어도\n모르고 지나갈 때가 많아요:
In movies, a cup can jump to a new spot
and most people never notice
EN.다 보는 것 같아도\n뇌는 보는 곳만 챙겨요:
It feels like you see everything,
but your brain only keeps what you look at
